intro: Financial services and government sectors bore the brunt of a concentrated wave of cybercrime activity between April 13 and April 30, 2026, with 23 articles documenting 16 high-severity incidents. Threat actors LockBit, Black Axe, and Chinese Transnational Organized Crime were observed targeting organizations globally, with notable impacts across the Caribbean, Germany, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. The e-commerce and gaming sectors also faced attacks, while two informational reports provided additional context.
